verdict.rationale: Solid's templates are JSX built on TypeScript, with an official TS starter template and a tsconfig that points `jsxImportSource` at solid-js. That implies TypeScript type-checks the JSX templates using Solid's own JSX typings. However, no evidence explicitly documents or demonstrates compile-time type errors inside templates. missing for 10: explicit documentation that JSX templates and props are type-checked at compile time, details of Solid's JSX type definitions, hands-on corroboration of template type errors being caught.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get compile-time type checking inside my component templates, not just script blocks

citations.quote: Solid is built on established tools like JSX and TypeScript and integrates with the Vite ecosystem.
Or for TypeScript: npx degit solidjs/templates/ts my-app
